job.title: Data Engineer I, Intelligent Talent Acquisition (ITA) - Data
job.pay_full: $101,300 – $160,000 a year base salary (Seattle), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Intelligent Talent Acquisition (ITA) is Amazon's people science and technology organization, made up of scientists, engineers, analysts and product people working to connect the right people to the right jobs fairly and precisely. Its Data team builds the foundational data infrastructure, reusable tools and analytics reporting that Amazon's hiring decisions rely on, with a strong focus on data privacy and integrity.
duties: Design and build scalable, secure data pipelines and infrastructure with AWS and big data tools
Build and maintain high-performance ETL processes for large, complex datasets
Architect end-to-end analytical solutions that are highly available, stable and cost-effective
Turn raw data into actionable insights through data modeling and integration
Apply best practices for data systems, data integrity and documentation
Spot opportunities to improve and automate processes
Work with business stakeholders to turn requirements into technical solutions
needs: Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience with one or more query languages (e.g. SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
Experience with one or more scripting languages (e.g. Python, KornShell)
nice: Big data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark or EMR
Any ETL tool such as Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI or DataStage
details.benefits: Base salary $101,300 – $160,000 a year (Seattle). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance with optional supplemental life plans, an employee assistance program, mental health support, a medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the application and hiring process for candidates with disabilities
